comment: Coupling counts for shell/platform/android. Maintained by ci/bin/android_embedder_ratchet.dart; run its "update" command instead of editing counts by hand.

history.reason: AndroidShellHolder now holds its engine as a FlutterEngine handle backed by EmbedderEngine. Each remaining use of the Shell behind the handle is a counted GetShell() call or EmbedderEngine cast until embedder.h covers it.

Wrap step, callbacks out: PlatformViewAndroid derives from PlatformViewEmbedder, so platform_view_android.h includes platform_view_embedder.h. Each deleted PlatformViewAndroid override then falls back to the embedder dispatch table.

Textures step 1: the texture classes stop including the JNI headers and include what they use themselves (display_list geometry conversions, Skia SkM44 and SkColorSpace, Impeller AiksContext), which those headers pulled in before. The classes move to shell/platform/embedder in the next two steps.

android_renderer.cc includes impeller/renderer/backend/vulkan/context_vk.h for IsSurfaceControlEnabled, which PlatformViewAndroid reached through a transitive include; the file moves to shell/platform/embedder/android in the next step

The Android renderer, contexts and surfaces moved to shell/platform/embedder/android; the Android embedder still includes them directly (the platform view creates the renderer, hybrid composition creates overlay surfaces, the holder shares contexts with spawned engines, FlutterMain picks the rendering API). The next steps put the renderer behind embedder.h and drop these includes.
